headline: Crystal Night Season Two Posts 480 Million Streaming Hours in Debut Week
summary: Lumebox's Crystal Night Season Two recorded 480 million streaming hours in its first seven days, the platform's highest debut-week total to date. The series premiered Friday in Los Angeles with all 8 episodes released simultaneously. Showrunner Maren Hollis confirmed renewal discussions for Season Three. Variety placed the series at No. 1 on the weekly streaming chart.
key_points: Crystal Night Season Two posted 480 million streaming hours in its debut week
All 8 episodes were released simultaneously on Friday in Los Angeles
Showrunner Maren Hollis confirmed Season Three renewal discussions
Variety ranked the series No. 1 on the weekly streaming chart
